title: Annals of the Drowned Hall
author: Vakka-Rei
text: In the ninth year the water came into the hall and did not leave. The Archein said this was punishment. The Hist said nothing, which the Archein also called punishment. I record only that the fish came in through the doors and that we ate well for a season, and that afterwards nobody would say the name of the hall aloud in Helstrom.
